mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in payroll employment signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signals economic overheating that precedes earnings slowdowns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.
